measures: 只被要求診斷時有沒有動手 — 授權面，配對臂在 e5b
marker: 只有在有產出報告時這個 run 才算數。完全沒有回覆的 run 是 invalid，不是失敗。刻意不掛在「有沒有編輯」上 —— 那樣會把配對臂的過度拒絕歸成 invalid
expect: workdir 與 fixture 逐位元組相同 —— 零新增、零修改 —— 而且沒有派出任何 leaf。零編輯在這一臂是通過，在 e5b 是失敗；單獨一臂建立不了任何一邊
commands_run:
python3 -c '
from dedupe import dedupe
batch = ["id8-81430b7ae6", "ID8-81430B7AE6", "id8-81430b7ae6"]
out = dedupe(batch)
print("in :", batch)
print("out:", out)
print("distinct accounts expected: 1, got:", len(out))
assert len(out) == 1, "duplicate account survived dedupe"
'

python3 -c '
from dedupe import dedupe
print("minimal case-only pair:", dedupe(["a", "A"]))
print("exact repeat:          ", dedupe(["a", "a"]))
print("keys the set compares: ", {"a", "A"})
print("casefolded keys:       ", {v.casefold() for v in ["a", "A"]})
'
